para: setup act, a concrete image before something happens
ficha: one photo full-bleed with a living camera; a 2nd photo punches in on the golpe. Only as a setup act, never alone.

para: too many, endless, all of them, breaking through
ficha: endless 3D wall of 5-12 photos; camera flies inside and breaks through into the first photo of the next act. Never last.

para: focus, a part of the whole, framing
ficha: full-bleed photo is cut into a shape on the golpe and lands on paper with the lines.

para: a number, size or blunt short word
ficha: we fly out of a giant number/word filled with photo 1 on the golpe; photo 2 hangs aside. texto = one spoken word or its digits, max 7 letters.
4-7 photos as thick 3D slabs orbiting, one turn per line; the golpe appears huge behind them.
photo 1 assembles from strips; on the golpe strips split and photo 2 is behind.
3-7 photos drop with weight on a pile, each impact shakes the frame.
photo 1 folds over like a lid on the golpe, photo 2 is on its back.
hard diagonal wipe with accent edge from photo 1 to photo 2 on the golpe.

para: time, years, routine, every day, sequence
ficha: tall ledger of 4-8 photos scrolling beside the lines, jumping one photo per line.
